spells.name: Fire Bolt
phrases: Make a ranged spell attack against the target
the target takes 1d10 Fire damage
A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn’t being worn or carried

spells.name: Prestidigitation
phrases: you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time

spells.name: Detect Magic
phrases: you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself
you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura
you learn the spell’s school of magic
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead

spells.name: Magic Missile
phrases: three glowing darts of magical force
strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range
A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target
The darts all strike simultaneously
spells.scalingPhrase: one more dart for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Misty Step
phrases: you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see

spells.name: Fireball
spells.components: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)
phrases: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw
taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
Flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried start burning
spells.scalingPhrase: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)
phrases: create up to four torch-size lights
each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius
combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike
As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet

spells.name: Darkness
spells.components: V, M (bat fur and a piece of coal)
phrases: magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere
Darkvision can’t see through it
to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object
an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled

spells.name: Druidcraft
phrases: you create one of the following effects within range

spells.name: Faerie Fire
phrases: Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light
if it fails a Dexterity saving throw
Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it

spells.name: Longstrider
spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
phrases: You touch a creature
The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends
spells.scalingPhrase: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1

spells.name: Pass without Trace
spells.components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)
phrases: a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation
a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks
leave no tracks
